### Key Risks

- **Heavy sedation and grogginess:** Extreme drowsiness, confusion, and lingering next-day fogginess.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-JfDoVdORFepEDTmZaP9BMipJBvdfr1t1HVUEkK6SgAXSdmVylRH7EfZaurVC2mSD6bqV8Vm5wc8v6bcEpJ-R8DynLvXRGMmC8O2xS5iteEMg_a6CmSTQcRnExWdqYRbHna5zx6PiT2gRFBWcQMFdSru0uFnvtmKFIcCVy4m3yEBPeSbTzvibYRZeg1aBAJ9g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12c72UzQddECNmjtoZKxt5prBm_nEUunk5t2G2xt7YonVrisAE7Wi2rcTiRoB01Q5H-uHbBrOZ47P6RlPmJ0HoY4p6gmviw8EuhjE03oO8pINCPxi_Jaw6SRq6vxT6xSu3V2DQ6wc3xY4PBKlz4IVb0HBVy9FDHvjaQL2Kjy3gUdZPSu)
- **Impaired coordination and judgment:** Higher risk of dizziness, falls, accidents, or sleep-related behaviors.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1y3VaparGHV2hgrhioMurFGd9oNcPz8PuOMPJWM14A8j22-VkIlMdkU2Y4F3_OGYyjZKyVSMCjXTPPwXN8nXBPJxcM-jAovkaOPLlncElD77GDEu7xhhAGtD2kcX3I8E28FroPOQQ-S0PxXjBw0ISt_gHMG6FUH6ehVb3_zMzA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12c72UzQddECNmjtoZKxt5prBm_nEUunk5t2G2xt7YonVrisAE7Wi2rcTiRoB01Q5H-uHbBrOZ47P6RlPmJ0HoY4p6gmviw8EuhjE03oO8pINCPxi_Jaw6SRq6vxT6xSu3V2DQ6wc3xY4PBKlz4IVb0HBVy9FDHvjaQL2Kjy3gUdZPSu)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXL94zyoltgaGwiNB6KjJRpN4zbP3pwg2oKnfElZ2fw0kEaBVHTRGHyXw1jeIRkmZrILaw0W3Whp7MZLOTFHFd0o5qDmlgd6tNOcWzt55guvg0nSDXbU3wkqlIFs1WJIZrL5nGzdwp8AskdGvVKErjQ6W_nt6PSg)
- **Slowed breathing:** Severe central nervous system depression can slow breathing, especially in older adults, people with sleep apnea, or those taking other sedating medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX1rmrg9SFhYZYrXR7PrXlRT4jTpgbANiqxjgEpc8vY9a_ZCxSjgyXgi7eNvGIo9MnEOEUOen6cjnX4ZHJnQ1IL5E9k-IDvdDU8HKlByLqBp06lZQvwqX5hDBEtAF3kW4pYVXMA0hptLn90-4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12c72UzQddECNmjtoZKxt5prBm_nEUunk5t2G2xt7YonVrisAE7Wi2rcTiRoB01Q5H-uHbBrOZ47P6RlPmJ0HoY4p6gmviw8EuhjE03oO8pINCPxi_Jaw6SRq6vxT6xSu3V2DQ6wc3xY4PBKlz4IVb0HBVy9FDHvjaQL2Kjy3gUdZPSu)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-JfDoVdORFepEDTmZaP9BMipJBvdfr1t1HVUEkK6SgAXSdmVylRH7EfZaurVC2mSD6bqV8Vm5wc8v6bcEpJ-R8DynLvXRGMmC8O2xS5iteEMg_a6CmSTQcRnExWdqYRbHna5zx6PiT2gRFBWcQMFdSru0uFnvtmKFIcCVy4m3yEBPeSbTzvibYRZeg1aBAJ9g)
- **Worse sleep quality:** Alcohol disrupts sleep stages and reduces restorative rest even if it makes you feel sleepy.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12c72UzQddECNmjtoZKxt5prBm_nEUunk5t2G2xt7YonVrisAE7Wi2rcTiRoB01Q5H-uHbBrOZ47P6RlPmJ0HoY4p6gmviw8EuhjE03oO8pINCPxi_Jaw6SRq6vxT6xSu3V2DQ6wc3xY4PBKlz4IVb0HBVy9FDHvjaQL2Kjy3gUdZPSu)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXCHgvmp5etABCSRRJZBuKXCIMXBwD066_EXFZvCPKtMJq2vjdOL5k_yR68YIhDc8c6m-aCNTMfL0xkqOjc0vZ0n-ThbYRHsvqO59DWum64FPMNqJJv1sS0ZTWQnWswindS6Uw08tU)

### Safer Practices

- **Choose one or the other:** Skip Unisom if you have been drinking alcohol, and avoid alcohol while using it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12c72UzQddECNmjtoZKxt5prBm_nEUunk5t2G2xt7YonVrisAE7Wi2rcTiRoB01Q5H-uHbBrOZ47P6RlPmJ0HoY4p6gmviw8EuhjE03oO8pINCPxi_Jaw6SRq6vxT6xSu3V2DQ6wc3xY4PBKlz4IVb0HBVy9FDHvjaQL2Kjy3gUdZPSu)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-JfDoVdORFepEDTmZaP9BMipJBvdfr1t1HVUEkK6SgAXSdmVylRH7EfZaurVC2mSD6bqV8Vm5wc8v6bcEpJ-R8DynLvXRGMmC8O2xS5iteEMg_a6CmSTQcRnExWdqYRbHna5zx6PiT2gRFBWcQMFdSru0uFnvtmKFIcCVy4m3yEBPeSbTzvibYRZeg1aBAJ9g)
- **Allow a full rest window:** Plan for 7 to 8 hours of sleep after taking Unisom, and avoid driving or operating machinery if you feel drowsy the next day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXtUtFcbzumpC-hgRCHfwYJXDteO7b20DcJrXfiGs6PAUT4BQKTVHxVYZz51q5HJBulP4e4y11ugVLh_MTu63sQciiqbky8yPO_eatHs6cOSLIhYPgf0WO8R3uNA0XkEjOVguA9JcC6FQ5sZX2pCq-xt2DRDNZ-UfKvY4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12c72UzQddECNmjtoZKxt5prBm_nEUunk5t2G2xt7YonVrisAE7Wi2rcTiRoB01Q5H-uHbBrOZ47P6RlPmJ0HoY4p6gmviw8EuhjE03oO8pINCPxi_Jaw6SRq6vxT6xSu3V2DQ6wc3xY4PBKlz4IVb0HBVy9FDHvjaQL2Kjy3gUdZPSu)
- **Seek urgent care if needed:** Get immediate medical help if you or someone else experiences trouble breathing, extreme confusion, fainting, or difficulty waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-JfDoVdORFepEDTmZaP9BMipJBvdfr1t1HVUEkK6SgAXSdmVylRH7EfZaurVC2mSD6bqV8Vm5wc8v6bcEpJ-R8DynLvXRGMmC8O2xS5iteEMg_a6CmSTQcRnExWdqYRbHna5zx6PiT2gRFBWcQMFdSru0uFnvtmKFIcCVy4m3yEBPeSbTzvibYRZeg1aBAJ9g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXX1rmrg9SFhYZYrXR7PrXlRT4jTpgbANiqxjgEpc8vY9a_ZCxSjgyXgi7eNvGIo9MnEOEUOen6cjnX4ZHJnQ1IL5E9k-IDvdDU8HKlByLqBp06lZQvwqX5hDBEtAF3kW4pYVXMA0hptLn90-4)

You can review interaction details on [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1y3VaparGHV2hgrhioMurFGd9oNcPz8PuOMPJWM14A8j22-VkIlMdkU2Y4F3_OGYyjZKyVSMCjXTPPwXN8nXBPJxcM-jAovkaOPLlncElD77GDEu7xhhAGtD2kcX3I8E28FroPOQQ-S0PxXjBw0ISt_gHMG6FUH6ehVb3_zMzA) or read more about mixing doxylamine and alcohol on [Ubie Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-JfDoVdORFepEDTmZaP9BMipJBvdfr1t1HVUEkK6SgAXSdmVylRH7EfZaurVC2mSD6bqV8Vm5wc8v6bcEpJ-R8DynLvXRGMmC8O2xS5iteEMg_a6CmSTQcRnExWdqYRbHna5zx6PiT2gRFBWcQMFdSru0uFnvtmKFIcCVy4m3yEBPeSbTzvibYRZeg1aBAJ9g) . If you or someone you know is struggling with combining alcohol and sleep aids, support and treatment options are available through [The Recovery Village](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXL94zyoltgaGwiNB6KjJRpN4zbP3pwg2oKnfElZ2fw0kEaBVHTRGHyXw1jeIRkmZrILaw0W3Whp7MZLOTFHFd0o5qDmlgd6tNOcWzt55guvg0nSDXbU3wkqlIFs1WJIZrL5nGzdwp8AskdGvVKErjQ6W_nt6PSg).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF1y3VaparGHV2hgrhioMurFGd9oNcPz8PuOMPJWM14A8j22-VkIlMdkU2Y4F3_OGYyjZKyVSMCjXTPPwXN8nXBPJxcM-jAovkaOPLlncElD77GDEu7xhhAGtD2kcX3I8E28FroPOQQ-S0PxXjBw0ISt_gHMG6FUH6ehVb3_zMzA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-JfDoVdORFepEDTmZaP9BMipJBvdfr1t1HVUEkK6SgAXSdmVylRH7EfZaurVC2mSD6bqV8Vm5wc8v6bcEpJ-R8DynLvXRGMmC8O2xS5iteEMg_a6CmSTQcRnExWdqYRbHna5zx6PiT2gRFBWcQMFdSru0uFnvtmKFIcCVy4m3yEBPeSbTzvibYRZeg1aBAJ9g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXL94zyoltgaGwiNB6KjJRpN4zbP3pwg2oKnfElZ2fw0kEaBVHTRGHyXw1jeIRkmZrILaw0W3Whp7MZLOTFHFd0o5qDmlgd6tNOcWzt55guvg0nSDXbU3wkqlIFs1WJIZrL5nGzdwp8AskdGvVKErjQ6W_nt6PSg)Are you asking because you **already combined** them tonight, or are you **planning** how to manage sleep? Slowed breathing: Severe central nervous system depression can slow breathing, especially in older adults, people with sleep apnea, or those taking other sedating medications. Worse sleep quality: Alcohol disrupts sleep stages and reduces restorative rest even if it makes you feel sleepy.

items.title: Safer Practices
items.text: Choose one or the other: Skip Unisom if you have been drinking alcohol, and avoid alcohol while using it. Allow a full rest window: Plan for 7 to 8 hours of sleep after taking Unisom, and avoid driving or operating machinery if you feel drowsy the next day. Seek urgent care if needed: Get immediate medical help if you or someone else experiences trouble breathing, extreme confusion, fainting, or difficulty waking up.
